text: Namaste bhai. Mera ek grocery ka order hai jo kal deliver hone wala hai, lekin ek problem ho gayi hai. Mujhe wo order kisi doosre address pe chahiye kyunki main kal apne parents ke ghar jaa raha hoon sheher ke doosre kone mein. Mera current address change karna hai delivery ke liye, please isko kisi senior ya team ko escalate kar do jo yeh address update kar sake kyunki automated system se nahi ho raha hai.
